assign.request: Pilot: cheap models grade finished tasks and rank themselves. Pick 5 landed tasks, have 3 cheap OpenRouter models + 1 Sonnet reference each audit all 5 (structured scores -3..3, review check, missing items), compute consensus with a node script (never by hand), write audit.jsonl + consensus.json per task, report.md with the model ranking and a go/no-go line. Budget $8.
steps: Add audit.jsonl schema + write audit.mjs (consensus, objective checks)
Pick 5 landed tasks, incl. ai2-inbox-read as the known failure
Write the minion brief with scoring anchors at the top
Spawn 4 auditor minions (gpt-6-luna, deepseek-v4.1-flash, gemini-3.8-flash, claude-sonnet-5 reference), each auditing all 5 tasks
Write report.md: failures by consensus, review accuracy, value per task, model ranking, go/no-go

decision.question: which 5 landed tasks for the pilot
options: only 2026-10-01/02 tasks with review reports (just 2: line-filter, local-ai)
widen to any landed task with requirements.md+owner-words.md
decision.chose: ai2-inbox-read (09-30, the named known failure), line-filter, local-ai (both reviewed), inspect (landed, high cost $27, 15 owner-check items missing — a good stress case), token-efficiency (landed, plain)
decision.why: brief requires ai2-inbox-read regardless of date; only 2 other 10-01/02 tasks have a review report, so the 5th and 6th slots go to other genuinely-landed tasks (inspect, token-efficiency) rather than stretching the review-report preference past what exists

log.msg: built audit.jsonl schema (jsonl-schema.mjs) + Server/audit.mjs myself (small, non-UI plumbing my own task needs) rather than a minion — writes consensus.json per task: median/agreement per score, missing-items union (2+ auditors), value=q/max(cost,1), FAILED flag, objective checks (files_ok/syntax_ok/urls_ok, best-effort — files named in a task's own action-edit lines, not a full git diff; noted as a pilot limit in report.md), and model-ladder distances. Dry-run on the 5 picked tasks with 0 audit lines: runs clean, no crash.
